'''Clone counselors''' were individuals who assisted the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a member of [[Breakout Squad]] suggested to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] that [[Sharp (clone trooper)|Sharp]], in actuality a [[Unidentified Clawdite bounty hunter|Clawdite]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], was acting strangely and should see the counselors.<ref name="TCWSM3">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Clone counselors were first referenced in [[Ryder Windham]]'s novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''.
